supp_definition_1: Manage the maintenance and optimisation of physical assets across the campus network. They oversee building and infrastructure maintenance, support asset planning and major projects, and help maintain compliance with related organisational and government requirements.

name: SECURITY
main_definition: Security professionals protect people, assets and operations by managing security risk and controls, incident and emergency preparedness and response, and business continuity and crisis arrangements
supp_definition_1: Safeguard people, property and assets across a diverse campus network. They manage security operations, incident response and risk mitigation strategies to ensure a safe and secure learning environment.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE DELIVERY
main_definition: Infrastructure Delivery professionals manage capital works projects, overseeing planning, execution, and compliance to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities.
supp_definition_1: Manage the planning, execution and governance of large-scale capital works projects. They oversee project delivery, contractor management, risk mitigation and budget control to ensure infrastructure investments align with TAFE NSW objectives and regulatory requirements.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM DELIVERY
main_definition: Infrastructure Program Delivery professionals oversee capital works programs to ensure timely, budget-aligned delivery that meets strategic infrastructure goals.
supp_definition_1: Manage large-scale capital works programs and projects, overseeing planning, execution, risk, and stakeholder engagement. They ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with strategic infrastructure priorities.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM OPERATIONS SUPPORT
main_definition: Infrastructure Program Operations Support professionals provide governance, planning and analysis to support delivery of capital works programs.
supp_definition_1: Provide governance, planning, scheduling and analytical support for capital works programs. They develop frameworks, monitor performance and ensure compliance with policies to help enable effective program execution.

name: INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM DESIGN
main_definition: Infrastructure Program Design professionals develop proposals and business cases to guide future capital works projects.
supp_definition_1: Develop investment proposals, business cases and feasibility assessments for infrastructure projects. They analyse demand, optimise project scope and align investment strategies with organisational and government priorities to support informed program decision-making.

name: PROPERTY
main_definition: Property professionals manage and optimise the property portfolio, overseeing leasing, strategy, and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
supp_definition_1: Oversee the management, optimisation and strategic use of TAFE NSW's property portfolio. They develop property strategies, manage leasing and asset utilisation and ensure compliance with legal, financial and regulatory requirements.

name: LEASING
main_definition: Leasing professionals manage leases, licences, and land agreements to optimise the property portfolio.
supp_definition_1: Manage property leases, licences and land agreements to optimise the organisation’s real estate portfolio. They develop leasing strategies, negotiate agreements, ensure compliance with legal and policy requirements and oversee lease administration.

name: PROPERTY OPERATIONS
main_definition: Property Operations professionals manage transactions, strategy, and asset recycling to optimise property use and ensure financial sustainability.
supp_definition_1: Manage portfolio strategy, property transactions and asset recycling to optimise the organisation’s property assets. They oversee acquisitions, divestments and property-related projects while developing governance frameworks and policies to ensure compliance, financial sustainability and strategic asset use.

name: STRATEGIC ASSET PLANNING
main_definition: Strategic Asset Planning professionals develop long-term capital strategies and manage asset lifecycles to align infrastructure investments with organisational and government priorities.
supp_definition_1: Develop and oversee long-term asset and capital strategies to ensure TAFE NSW's education infrastructure meets organisational needs. They manage asset lifecycle planning, policy development and investment governance, ensuring alignment with government frameworks and TAFE NSW objectives. Their work includes capital project planning and oversight, leveraging asset data and financial modelling to optimise infrastructure investments.

name: ASSET MANAGEMENT STRATEGY AND PLANNING
main_definition: Asset Management Strategy and Planning professionals develop long-term asset strategies and oversee lifecycle planning to align infrastructure with future needs.
supp_definition_1: Develop and implement long-term asset strategies to ensure education infrastructure supports organisational objectives and future needs. They oversee asset lifecycle planning and strategy and policy development, ensuring alignment with government requirements and operational priorities.

name: ASSET INFORMATION AND DATA
main_definition: Asset Information and Data professionals use analytics and reporting to support asset planning and investment decisions.
supp_definition_1: Leverage data analytics and reporting to optimise asset management and planning. They develop insights on asset condition, utilisation and lifecycle trends to support evidence-based decision-making and long-term investment strategies.

name: CAPITAL PLANNING
main_definition: Capital Planning professionals oversee infrastructure funding to ensure capital programs are strategically allocated and aligned with organisational and government priorities.
supp_definition_1: Oversee the governance, assurance and strategic allocation of infrastructure funding to support the construction, maintenance and renewal of education assets. They develop long-term capital forecasts, manage investment pipelines and ensure capital programs align with organisational objectives, asset management policies and government requirements.

name: SUSTAINABILITY
main_definition: Sustainability professionals embed environmental sustainability strategies, ensuring regulatory compliance and driving sustainable practices across TAFE NSW's built environment and campus operations.
supp_definition_1: Develop and implement strategies to enhance environmental sustainability and resource efficiency across TAFE NSW's education infrastructure. They lead initiatives to reduce environmental impact, ensure compliance with sustainability regulations, and drive innovation in sustainable practices.

name: LEGAL
main_definition: Legal professionals provide legal advice and representation to manage legal risk and support sound decisions.
supp_definition_1: Provide expert legal advice, representation, and strategic counsel to safeguard TAFE NSW's interests and ensure compliance with its legal and regulatory obligations. They focus primarily on interpreting legislation, managing legal risks, handling disputes and litigation, and drafting critical legal documents, supported by efficient operational frameworks that enable the effective delivery of these legal services

name: LEGAL ADVISORY
main_definition: Legal Advisory professionals provide expert legal advice, manage risks, ensure compliance, and represent the organisation to protect its interests and support its objectives.
supp_definition_1: Provide expert legal advice and representation to TAFE NSW on a broad range of matters. They focus on interpreting legislation, managing legal risks, ensuring compliance and representing the organisation in disputes and litigation to protect TAFE NSW’s interests and support its objectives.

name: LEGAL OPERATIONS
main_definition: Legal Operations professionals enhance legal service delivery by managing systems, procedures, resources, and knowledge to improve performance.
supp_definition_1: Enhance the operational performance of TAFE NSW's legal function. They focus on developing and managing practice management systems, administrative procedures, resource coordination and knowledge management protocols to support the delivery of legal services.

name: LIBRARY
main_definition: Library professionals manage collections, resources and services that support students and staff in accessing information, learning materials and study spaces.

name: MARKETING
main_definition: Marketing professionals design and deliver programs, campaigns and activities that promote TAFE NSW’s education and training, strengthen its brand and drive student enrolments and engagement.
supp_definition_1: Develop and implement strategies to promote TAFE NSW's education and training programs. They analyse market trends, create campaigns, manage brand presence and engage target audiences to help TAFE NSW achieve its student enrolment objectives.

name: EVENTS MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Events Management professionals plan, coordinate and deliver internal and external events that promote TAFE NSW, build engagement with stakeholders and support student, community and industry relationships.
supp_definition_1: Plan, coordinate and manage a range of internal and external events and promotional activities. They manage logistics, vendor relations and budgets to deliver successful experiences that build stakeholder engagement and support TAFE NSW objectives.

name: INTEGRATED MARKETING
main_definition: Integrated Marketing professionals plan, deliver and evaluate marketing programs and campaigns across channels to build awareness, strengthen the brand, generate enrolments and support engagement with TAFE NSW’s education and training.
supp_definition_1: Design, implement and evaluate targeted promotional activities across various channels. They aim to achieve specific marketing objectives, such as increasing awareness, generating enrolments or driving engagement for TAFE NSW's education and training programs.

name: MARKET RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS
main_definition: Market Research and Analysis professionals collect, analyse and interpret data on markets, students, competitors and industry trends to provide insights that guide marketing strategies and organisational decision-making.
supp_definition_1: Gather, analyse and interpret data about markets, prospective students, competitors and industry trends. They provide insights to inform marketing strategies, ensuring efforts are data-driven.

name: PARTNERSHIPS
main_definition: Partnerships professionals connect TAFE NSW with external organisations, communities and individuals, to drive growth, foster collaboration and build relationships that maximise the value and impact of TAFE NSW's education and training.

name: BUSINESS RELATIONSHIPS AND GROWTH
main_definition: Business Relationships and Growth professionals drive revenue through relationships with business, corporate and government clients, securing new sales, growing existing accounts and managing bid and tender responses.
supp_definition_1: Manage client relationships and drive growth through business-to-business sales. They identify opportunities, deliver tailored solutions and build long-term partnerships to meet revenue/growth targets objectives and ensure client satisfaction.

name: BIDS AND TENDERS
main_definition: Bids and Tenders professionals manage formal bid and tender processes from preparation to submission.
supp_definition_1: Manage and coordinate the development of tenders and grant applications. They focus on overseeing the bid lifecycle from opportunity identification to submission, coordinating input from various stakeholders, ensuring adherence to requirements, and developing persuasive responses to secure new contracts and funding.

name: ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Account Management professionals strengthen existing client relationships to drive retention, satisfaction and growth.
supp_definition_1: Nurture and expand existing business client relationships and develop sales-focused partnerships to drive retention, client satisfaction and growth. They focus on understanding client/partner needs, identify new opportunities to expand offerings, manage contract renewals, and co-develop solutions with partners to achieve revenue targets from established accounts and new partner channels.

name: BUSINESS SALES
main_definition: Business Sales professionals identify, pursue and secure new business opportunities, expanding TAFE NSW’s client base and revenue.

name: PARTNERSHIPS STRATEGY AND SUPPORT
main_definition: Partnerships Strategy and Support professionals manage the strategies, systems and processes that underpin growth and engagement activities.

name: PRINT SERVICES
main_definition: Print Services professionals deliver, coordinate and improve print production, print technology and related distribution services to meet organisational and student/customer needs.

name: PRINT OPERATIONS
main_definition: Print Operations professionals operate and coordinate print production and distribution services, managing workflows, equipment, materials and service delivery to produce quality print products efficiently and on time.

name: Enterprise Print Services
main_definition: Enterprise Print Services professionals manage and improve enterprise print systems, standards, suppliers and solutions to support efficient, consistent and compliant print services across the organisation.

name: PROCUREMENT
main_definition: Procurement professionals plan categories, conduct competitive procurements, negotiate and manage contracts, and drive value for money while meeting probity and sustainability requirements.
supp_definition_1: Strategically manage the acquisition of goods and services for TAFE NSW, optimising value for money, ensuring probity and compliance, and fostering effective supplier relationships. They focus on developing and implementing procurement strategies, policies, and operations that support TAFE NSW's educational delivery and broader government objectives

name: CATEGORY MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Category Procurement professionals develop and implement sourcing strategies to optimise costs, strengthen supplier relationships, and drive value through market insights.
supp_definition_1: Develop and implement long-term strategic plans for specific categories of goods and services across TAFE NSW. They focus on conducting deep market analysis, understanding business needs, developing category strategies to drive value, fostering strategic supplier relationships, and monitoring category performance to inform ongoing procurement effectiveness

name: PROCUREMENT CONTRACT MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Procurement Contract Management professionals oversee procurement contracts from negotiation to close-out, ensuring compliance, managing risks, and maximising value to support organisational objectives.
supp_definition_1: Oversee the lifecycle of TAFE NSW's procurement contracts, from formation and negotiation through to execution, performance monitoring, and close-out. They focus on ensuring contract compliance, managing supplier performance, mitigating contractual risks, and maximising the value delivered through contractual agreements to support TAFE NSW objectives

name: PROCUREMENT OPERATIONS
main_definition: Procurement Operations professionals manage policies, processes, and systems to ensure efficient, compliant procurement that supports organisational and government objectives.
supp_definition_1: Develop, implement, and manage the policies, processes, systems, and capabilities that underpin TAFE NSW's procurement function. They focus on ensuring efficient, compliant, and effective procurement practices that enable the achievement of TAFE NSW and government objectives

name: PROCUREMENT OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT AND SUPPORT
main_definition: Procurement Policy and Operations professionals manage policies and processes, providing analysis, reporting, and training to support effective procurement practices.
supp_definition_1: Develop and manage procurement policies and procedures, and provide operational support, analysis, reporting, and capability development. They focus on ensuring procurement activities are efficient and compliant, and that TAFE NSW staff are equipped with the knowledge and tools for effective procurement practice.

name: PROCUREMENT SYSTEMS
main_definition: Procurement Systems professionals manage platforms and tools to ensure reliability, data accuracy, and continuous improvement for usability and compliance.
supp_definition_1: Manage and optimise TAFE NSW's procurement platforms, e-procurement tools, and related technologies. They focus on ensuring system reliability and efficiency, data integrity, user support, and the implementation of system enhancements to improve usability, compliance, and reporting capabilities.

name: STRATEGIC SOURCING
main_definition: Strategic Sourcing professionals lead complex procurement initiatives, managing sourcing plans, supplier evaluations, and negotiations to secure optimal and compliant outcomes.
supp_definition_1: Lead and execute complex procurement initiatives to secure optimal value and compliant outcomes for TAFE NSW across significant spend categories. They focus on developing and implementing sourcing plans, managing competitive market engagement processes, conducting supplier evaluations, negotiating commercial terms and establishing contractual agreements.

name: PROGRAM AND PROJECT MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Program and Project Management professionals plan, govern and manage portfolios, programs and projects to realise agreed outcomes.
supp_definition_1: Drive the planning, execution and governance of programs and projects to achieve organisational objectives. They oversee delivery, risk management and stakeholder engagement while ensuring governance, reporting, and operational support structures enable efficiency, compliance and strategic alignment.

name: PROGRAM/PROJECT MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Program/Project Management professionals plan, lead and manage programs and projects to deliver outcomes on time, within scope and budget.
supp_definition_1: Plan, execute and oversee programs/projects to achieve organisational objectives. They manage scope, planning, timelines, budgets and stakeholder engagement, ensuring successful delivery, risk mitigation and alignment with strategic priorities.

name: PROGRAM/PROJECT AUXILLIARY AND SUPPORT
main_definition: Program/Project Auxiliary and Support professionals provide governance, reporting and administrative support for programs and projects.
supp_definition_1: Provide oversight, analysis and operational support to ensure effective program/project delivery. They manage program/project governance frameworks, reporting, scheduling and administrative functions to optimise program/project outcomes, efficiency and compliance.

name: STORES AND LOGISTICS
main_definition: Stores and Logistics professionals manage the transport, storage and maintenance of TAFE NSW’s fleet, plant, equipment and consumables to ensure assets are safe, available and efficiently managed.
supp_definition_1: Plan, manage and execute the movement, storage, maintenance and lifecycle of TAFE NSW’s fleet, plant and equipment and stores/consumables. They focus on ensuring these operational assets are available where and when needed, maintained in a safe and compliant condition, and managed efficiently throughout their lifecycle.

name: FLEET MANAGEMENT
main_definition: Fleet Management professionals manage the acquisition, operation, maintenance, compliance and disposal of TAFE NSW’s vehicle fleet.
supp_definition_1: Oversee the acquisition, operation, maintenance, compliance and disposal of TAFE NSW's vehicle fleet. They focus on ensuring vehicle safety, operational readiness, optimal utilisation, cost-effectiveness and adherence to all relevant transport legislation, road safety rules and TAFE NSW policies.

name: STORES AND LOGISTICS OPERATIONS
main_definition: Stores and Logistics Operations professionals manage day-to-day stores and logistics activities, including inventory control, ordering and receipting, and timely distribution of materials, equipment and consumables.
supp_definition_1: Manage the day-to-day operations of TAFE NSW's stores facilities and related logistical activities, including the handling of materials, equipment and consumables. They focus on efficient inventory management, stock control, materials ordering and receipting, safe storage, timely distribution and supporting TAFE NSW's logistical needs.

name: STRATEGIC ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: Strategic Engagement professionals build and manage long-term relationships with communities, industry and education stakeholders, using strategic consultation and outreach to foster collaboration, create shared value and strengthen TAFE NSW’s impact

name: ABORIGINAL COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: Aboriginal Community Engagement professionals build and maintain relationships with Aboriginal communities and organisations to identify needs and support culturally appropriate education and training.

name: COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: Community Engagement professionals build and maintain relationships with local communities and organisations to identify needs and support education and training.

name: EDUCATION SECTOR ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: Education Sector Engagement professionals develop and maintain partnerships across the education sector to share insights, collaborate and strengthen education and training outcomes.

name: INDUSTRY ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: Industry Engagement professionals manage relationships with industry stakeholders to identify opportunities for collaboration and inform the design and delivery of education and training.

name: INTERNATIONAL ENGAGEMENT
main_definition: International Engagement professionals develop and manage strategic partnerships with international governments, industry bodies and education organisations to support TAFE NSW's international objectives.

name: STRATEGIC POLICY
main_definition: Policy professionals develop and advise on enterprise policy frameworks that guide organisational decisions, set clear principles, and support TAFE NSW to align with government, education and industry directions. Strategic Policy professionals develop, analyse and advise on policy frameworks and reforms that guide organisational decision-making, support TAFE NSW in responding to government priorities, and best position it within the broader education and training sector to meet industry and community needs.

name: STUDENT SUPPORT
main_definition: Student Support professionals provide guidance, services and specialised assistance to students to support their academic progress and personal wellbeing whilst studying at TAFE NSW.

name: ABORIGINAL STUDENT SUPPORT
main_definition: Aboriginal Student Support professionals provide tailored support and advocacy for Aboriginal students to help them succeed academically and personally at TAFE NSW.
supp_definition_1: Provide culturally safe guidance and assistance to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students. They facilitate access to academic and personal support services, fostering an inclusive environment to enhance educational participation and achievement.

name: COUNSELLING AND CAREER SUPPORT
main_definition: Counselling and Career Support professionals provide counselling and career guidance to help students address personal, social and study-related needs.
supp_definition_1: Work with students to understand their personal and social needs and provide formal counselling and advice to help them succeed in their studies and subsequent career.

name: DISABILITY AND ACCESS SUPPORT
main_definition: Disability and Access Support professionals coordinate resources to provide students with disability equitable access to education and training.
supp_definition_1: Help to provide accessible and equitable education opportunities for students with disabilities. They facilitate reasonable adjustments and assist students with adaptive technology, administrative tasks and other services as needed.

name: INTERNATIONAL STUDENT SUPPORT
main_definition: International Student Support professionals provide services and guidance to international students to support their academic success and personal adjustment while studying at TAFE NSW.
supp_definition_1: Provide targeted guidance, welfare services and specialised assistance to international students to facilitate their successful academic and personal adjustment to studying with TAFE NSW and living in Australia. They focus on delivering culturally responsive support, advising on matters such as visa conditions, accommodation and wellbeing, and connecting students with relevant services to enhance their engagement, retention and overall experience.

name: MULTICULTURAL STUDENT SUPPORT
main_definition: Multicultural Student Support professionals assist students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds with guidance, resources and support to overcome participation barriers and succeed in study.
supp_definition_1: Assist students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds to succeed in their studies. They offer guidance on cultural adjustment, connect students with resources and help address barriers to participation.
